# Close wrap, Wed Oct 14, 2026 (Research Inc., ~4:30 PM ET)

**Hot CPI = worst day since July; AI/chips crushed, defensives bid.**

1. **Indexes:** S&P 500 7,718.94 (−1.11%), Nasdaq 26,692.87 (−1.88%), Dow 51,621.48 (−0.09%); IWM −1.93% (X traders flag a break below its 200-day). Sept CPI 3.7% YoY / core 2.6%, both above est; rate-hike odds for Oct 28 jumped. ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/stock-markets-earnings-bonds-artificial-intelligence-704d3190f0fba2908df07c85f26346ec), [X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2110463755670667536); closes via box yfinance)
2. **Rates:** 10y touched ~5.31% intraday, but long bonds reversed late (TLT +0.6%). ([Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/26/10/62360140/nasdaq-100-drops-1-on-hot-cpi-soxx-falls-7th-day-stock-market-today), [X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2110463750406897794))
3. **Sectors:** XLK −2.98%, SOXX −4.50%; XLV +2.53%, XLP +2.22%, XLE +0.64%.
4. **Covered names:** AMD −5.73%, META −3.27%, NVDA −3.16%, AVGO −3.10%, ASML −3.94% despite FY raise; UNH +4.73%, LLY +3.62%, COST +2.87%, JPM +1.16%, BLK +0.72%; BAC −4.76%, MS −2.75%.
5. **AI optics shock:** LITE −9.28%, COHR/AAOI/CIEN hit too; group repricing on AI-capex funding fears (AVGO/INTC CEO comments), not a company miss. LITE reports ~Nov 3–5. ([24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/14/applied-optoelectronics-dives-9-as-ai-funding-fears-hit-optical-stocks-coherent-slides-7-lumentum-drops-7/), [Investing](https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/why-is-lumentum-stock-sliding-today-93CH-4881056))
6. **After hours:** No covered names reported after the bell in our sources.
7. **Tomorrow:** PPI 8:30 ET. Houthi strike on an Aramco site keeps oil firm (WTI ~$95, Brent ~$106). ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2109873335450358038))

## Ideas (long-only, swing)
- **UNH**, swing: Follow-through (+4.7%) on raised 2026 EPS ≥$20.50 + defensive rotation. Conf: med. Risk: MA/policy headlines; extended after 2-day pop.
- **BLK**, swing: Green on a −1.1% tape after record AUM/$205B inflows. Conf: med. Risk: equity drawdown hits fees.
- **XLV**, swing: Rotation into health care on hot CPI (XLV +2.5% vs XLK −3%). Conf: low. Risk: one-day rotation reverses if PPI cools.

**Avoid:** BAC; airlines (DAL/UAL/AAL/LUV/ALK/JETS); AI optics group (LITE/COHR/AAOI/CIEN) to 10/21. ASML idea dropped from signals; no new chip entries until yields settle.
